# Subset Neural/glial and Schwann cells

### NOTE - The reason why we chose these immune cells specifically is because they have the greatest increase in communication within the muscle with cachexia

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

ng_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Neural/glial cells")
schwann_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Schwann cells")
ng_schwann_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Neural/glial cells", "Schwann cells"))
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined, all_genes)
```



# Plot UMAP 

## Highlighting cells

```{r}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_combined$highlight_cells <- "Other"

sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Neural/glial cells"] <- "Neural/glial cells"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Schwann cells"] <- "Schwann cells"


DimPlot(
  sc_combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "highlight_cells",
  cols = c(
    "Other" = "grey85",
    "Neural/glial cells" = "#FF7F00",
    "Schwann cells" = "#FFA64D"
  ),
  pt.size = 1, raster = FALSE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = NULL, x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
rm(sc_combined)
```


## By condition

```{r}
DimPlot(ng_integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

DimPlot(schwann_integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```



# CTLs and tumour-bearing combined

```{r, include=FALSE}
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)



ng_integrated$condition <- ifelse(
  ng_integrated$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples,
  "CTL",
  "Tumour-bearing")

schwann_integrated$condition <- ifelse(
  schwann_integrated$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples,
  "CTL",
  "Tumour-bearing")



rm(ctl_samples)
```



# GO terms

## Get DEGs in tumour-bearing cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(ng_integrated) <- "orig.ident"
Idents(schwann_integrated) <- "orig.ident"



DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated <- FindMarkers(ng_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated <- FindMarkers(schwann_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```


## Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated)

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated)



DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated.csv")

write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated.csv")
```


## Take the row names of the specified genes in each condition that have an -2 > avg_log2FC > 0.2

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_up <- rownames(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated[DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated$avg_log2FC > 0.2,])

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_up <- rownames(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated[DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated$avg_log2FC > 0.2,])



DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_down <- rownames(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated[DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated$avg_log2FC < -0.2,])

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_down <- rownames(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated[DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated$avg_log2FC < -0.2,])
```


## Run GO analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_upgo <- enrichGO(gene = DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_up, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_upgo <- enrichGO(gene = DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_up, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")



DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_downgo <- enrichGO(gene = DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_down, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")

DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_downgo <- enrichGO(gene = DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_down, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")
```


## .csv for GO terms

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_upgo, file = "ng_integrated_upgo.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_upgo, file = "schwann_integrated_upgo.csv", row.names = TRUE)



write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_downgo, file = "ng_integrated_downgo.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_schwann_integrated_downgo, file = "schwann_integrated_downgo.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```


## Visualize GO terms

### Neural/glial cells Immune/inflammation response UP (11/56)

```{r}
immune_ng_up <- c(10, 11, 36, 42, 46, 47, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55)
go_immune_ng_up <- DEGs_cachectic_ng_integrated_upgo[immune_ng_up, ]

go_immune_ng_up$Description <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)$", "", go_immune_ng_up$Description)

ggplot(go_immune_ng_up, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP GO Integrated Neural/glial cells - Immune-related terms") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```

# Heatmap to show tumour communication to Neural/glial and Schwann cells

```{r}
tumour_to_neuro_counts_mat <- cellchat_tb_secreted@net$count[
  c("Tumour Malignant cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells"),
  c("Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")]

pheatmap(
  tumour_to_neuro_counts_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(15),
  breaks = seq(0, 15, length.out = 16),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
  )
```



# Heatmap of change in neural/glial and schwann cell communication within the muscle

```{r}
ctl_muscle_neuro_counts_mat <- cellchat_ctl_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")]

tb_muscle_neuro_counts_mat <- cellchat_tb_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")]

diff_counts_mat <- tb_muscle_neuro_counts_mat - ctl_muscle_neuro_counts_mat

n_neg <- 50   # -40 → 0
n_pos <- 50   # 0 → 40

# Create two color gradients
neg_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white"))(n_neg)
pos_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(n_pos)
colours <- c(neg_colours, pos_colours)

# Define breaks to match colors
breaks <- seq(-50, 50, length.out = length(colours) + 1)

# Plot
pheatmap(
  diff_counts_mat,
  color = colours,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}

```



# Enriched signaling pathways from Tumour to muscle neural/glial and schwann cells

```{r}
### Extract communication probabilities at the pathway level
netP_tb_secreted <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_tb_secreted, slot.name = "netP")

### Subset for enriched pathways for target cells to source cells
netP_tb_secreted <- netP_tb_secreted[
  netP_tb_secreted$source %in% c("Tumour Malignant cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells") & 
  netP_tb_secreted$target %in% c("Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"), 
]

### Get unique pathways from specified cells to target cells
unique(netP_tb_secreted$pathway_name)
```

## Dotplot of enriched signaling from tumour to muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
selectK(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "outgoing")
selectK(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "incoming")

selectK(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "outgoing")
selectK(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "incoming")

cellchat_ctl_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "outgoing", k = 6)
cellchat_ctl_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_ctl_secreted, pattern = "incoming", k = 5)

cellchat_tb_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "outgoing", k = 10)
cellchat_tb_secreted <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_tb_secreted, pattern = "incoming", k = 6)
```

# Enriched signaling pathways from Neural/glial and Schwann cells to all muscle cells

## CTLs

# Relative information flow of enriched neural/glial and schwann cell signaling pathways

## Load integrated muscle data (muscle+tumours won't work)

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/cellchat/integrated_cellchat_muscle.RData")

rm(cellchat_ctl_secreted, cellchat_ctl_ecm, cellchat_ctl_nps, cellchat_ctl_ccc, cellchat_end_secreted, cellchat_end_ecm, cellchat_end_nps, cellchat_end_ccc)
```

## Merge cellchat objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
object.list <- list("CTL" = cellchat_ctl_all, "Tumour-bearing" = cellchat_end_all)

names(object.list)

cellchat_merged_all <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
```


## Information flow of enriched pathways

### NOTE - Pathways highlighted BLUE are significantly higher in CTL, RED in TUMOUR-BEARING, BLACK are equal.

```{r}
rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = "Neural/glial cells", color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))

rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = "Schwann cells", color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))

rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = c("Neural/glial cells", "Schwann cells"), color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))
```

## Subset Nicoletti dataset for Neural/glial and Schwann cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(den_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

den_ng_schwann <- subset(den_combined, idents = "Neural/glial/Schwann cells")

rm(den_combined)
```


## Number of Neural/glial/Schwann cells in den_ng_schwann

```{r}
table(den_ng_schwann$orig.ident)
```


## DEGs for upregulated genes with denervation

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(den_ng_schwann) <- "orig.ident"

deg_den_2d <- FindMarkers(den_ng_schwann, ident.1 = "DEN2d", ident.2 = "CTL", logfc.threshold = 0.2, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

deg_den_5d <- FindMarkers(den_ng_schwann, ident.1 = "DEN5d", ident.2 = "CTL", logfc.threshold = 0.2, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

deg_den_15d <- FindMarkers(den_ng_schwann, ident.1 = "DEN15d", ident.2 = "CTL", logfc.threshold = 0.2, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```


## Subset for avg_log2FC > 0.2 and p_val_adj < 0.05

```{r, include=FALSE}
deg_den_2d <- subset(deg_den_2d, avg_log2FC > 0.2 & p_val_adj < 0.05)

deg_den_5d <- subset(deg_den_5d, avg_log2FC > 0.2 & p_val_adj < 0.05)

deg_den_15d <- subset(deg_den_15d, avg_log2FC > 0.2 & p_val_adj < 0.05)
```


## Get a list of genes upregulated with denervation at 2d, 5d, 15d

```{r, include=FALSE}
deg_den_2d_gene_list <- rownames(deg_den_2d)

deg_den_5d_gene_list <- rownames(deg_den_5d)

deg_den_15d_gene_list <- rownames(deg_den_15d)
```


## AddModuleScore

```{r, include=FALSE}
den_2d_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(ng_schwann_integrated, features = deg_den_2d_gene_list, name = "den_2d_score")

den_5d_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(ng_schwann_integrated, features = deg_den_5d_gene_list, name = "den_5d_score")

den_15d_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(ng_schwann_integrated, features = deg_den_15d_gene_list, name = "den_15d_score")



means_den_2d_score <- den_2d_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(average_den_2d_score = mean(signature_1den_2d_score, na.rm = TRUE))

means_den_5d_score <- den_5d_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(average_den_5d_score = mean(signature_1den_5d_score, na.rm = TRUE))

means_den_15d_score <- den_15d_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(average_den_15d_score = mean(signature_1den_15d_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}

```

## Number of Myonuclei in den_ng_schwann

```{r}
table(myonuclei_den$orig.ident)
```


## DEGs for upregulated genes with denervation

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(myonuclei_den) <- "orig.ident"

deg_den_2d <- FindMarkers(myonuclei_den, ident.1 = "DEN2d", ident.2 = "CTL", logfc.threshold = 0.2, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

deg_den_5d <- FindMarkers(myonuclei_den, ident.1 = "DEN5d", ident.2 = "CTL", logfc.threshold = 0.2, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

deg_den_15d <- FindMarkers(myonuclei_den, ident.1 = "DEN15d", ident.2 = "CTL", logfc.threshold = 0.2, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```


## Subset for avg_log2FC > 0.2 and p_val_adj < 0.05

```{r, include=FALSE}
deg_den_2d <- subset(deg_den_2d, avg_log2FC > 0.2 & p_val_adj < 0.05)

deg_den_5d <- subset(deg_den_5d, avg_log2FC > 0.2 & p_val_adj < 0.05)

deg_den_15d <- subset(deg_den_15d, avg_log2FC > 0.2 & p_val_adj < 0.05)
```


## Get a list of genes upregulated with denervation at 2d, 5d, 15d

```{r, include=FALSE}
deg_den_2d_gene_list <- rownames(deg_den_2d)

deg_den_5d_gene_list <- rownames(deg_den_5d)

deg_den_15d_gene_list <- rownames(deg_den_15d)
```


## AddModuleScore

```{r, include=FALSE}
den_2d_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(myonuclei_integrated, features = deg_den_2d_gene_list, name = "den_2d_score")

den_5d_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(myonuclei_integrated, features = deg_den_5d_gene_list, name = "den_5d_score")

den_15d_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(myonuclei_integrated, features = deg_den_15d_gene_list, name = "den_15d_score")



means_den_2d_score <- den_2d_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(average_den_2d_score = mean(signature_1den_2d_score, na.rm = TRUE))

means_den_5d_score <- den_5d_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(average_den_5d_score = mean(signature_1den_5d_score, na.rm = TRUE))

means_den_15d_score <- den_15d_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(average_den_15d_score = mean(signature_1den_15d_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_den_2d_score)
```

```{r}
print(means_den_5d_score)
```

```{r}
print(means_den_15d_score)
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(den_2d_score, features = "signature_1den_2d_score", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Denervation score (2 days)", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```
